name: Geometric abstract symbol
region: Germany, the United States and Japan
summary: One abstract shape, built from squares, circles, bars or loops, that stands for the organisation with no letters. The shape implies a direction, growth or a cycle, and is strong enough to stand alone on a sign or a coin.

philosophy.core_thesis: A pure form carries meaning by its structure alone: a square, a bar or a loop can say stability, growth or a cycle in every language.
design_principles: Build the symbol from 1–3 primitive shapes: a square, a circle, a bar or a band.
Imply one idea with one move: a diagonal for growth, a loop for a cycle, a rotation for motion.
Fill the shapes solid; let negative space form a second figure when it can.
Keep the symbol in a square of 1:1, with the shapes at 80–95% of the square.
Use one colour for the master, often a deep blue, a green or black.
Test the symbol at 16 px and at 2 m: the idea must read at both sizes with no change.
anti_patterns: A literal picture of the product
Thin lines under 6% of the symbol height

construction.grid: A square of 1:1 divided into 4–12 units; each corner and centre falls on a unit point.
construction.geometry: Squares, circles, bars and bands; diagonals at 45° or at a fixed angle that the system names.
construction.stroke_rule: Solid fills; where a band is used, its width is 12–25% of the symbol height.
construction.symmetry: Rotational symmetry of order 2, 3 or 4 is common; a single diagonal breaks mirror symmetry on purpose.
construction.detail_floor: No gap under 8% of the symbol height.

form.silhouette: A square or a circle at 1:1; the outer edge is a clean primitive shape.
form.letterforms: Not part of the symbol; a logotype in a neutral sans sits apart from it, at a gap of 50–100% of the symbol height.

colour.strategy: One deep, saturated colour, used flat; the symbol is also standard in black and in white.
colour.reversal_rule: The symbol is a solid silhouette, so white on a dark ground needs no change.

reproduction.clear_space: A quarter of the symbol height on each side; in a lock-up, the gap to the logotype is half the symbol height.
reproduction.media: Signs, coins and stamps, offset print, then screen icons.

emotion.target_response: Calm strength: the viewer sees a firm, timeless form and reads stability and ambition.

avoid_when: The audience must read the name in the mark to remember it.
The brief asks for a playful, hand-made or ornate tone.

modifiers.how: Keep the primitive shapes; add 2–4 bright flat colours and round the corners at 10–20% of the shape size.
Keep the silhouette; add a top-lit gradient, a highlight and a soft reflection.
